brief:
Political analyst Iyad al-Qara contended that recent statements by Mladinov "all move in the same direction," asserting the international official continues to openly adopt the Israeli position while furnishing justifications for Israeli conduct, according to Shehab Wire. Al-Qara characterized Mladinov's approach as fundamentally aligned with Israeli interests rather than serving as a neutral mediator.

The analyst emphasized that stability forces deployed in Palestinian territories face insurmountable obstacles to success without a complete Israeli military withdrawal. Al-Qara's remarks underscored skepticism toward international mediation efforts that he views as favoring one party in the conflict.
